text:
Any person who gives the City or any of its departments an insufficient check shall be charged a service charge, as prescribed by the City’s fee schedule, as authorized by K.S.A. 60-2610 as amended. (Ord. 20631 § 34, 1-13-26.)
State Law References: Limitation on service charge, K.S.A. 60-2610 .
title: Service charge for nonnegotiable or returned checks.
